presentation.description:
You need to configure patterns and triggers before it will work, 
open the configuration window to do that.  

For DualSense/Shock4 support, the controller needs to be connected wired (same as the game's)
and there can only be one of a type connected (e.g., only one DualSense, not two).

Currently supported triggers are:
- Cooldowns
- Near Aether Current
presentation.summary: Create vibration patterns for the controller and specify triggers to make it vibrate.

search.website_text:
A Final Fantasy XIV Quicklauncher (XIVLauncher) plugin. Allows one to create vibration patterns for the controller and specify triggers for them. ﻿# GentleTouch

A Final Fantasy XIV Quicklauncher (XIVLauncher) plugin.
Allows one to create vibration patterns for the controller and specify triggers for them.

Licensed under AGPLv3 or later.

## Features

- Create different vibration patterns
- Add cooldown triggers to perform patterns when its safe to activate the cooldown again
- Aether currents can be sensed via vibration when out-of-combat.

![Pattern Window](docs/patternWindow.jpg)
![Trigger Window](docs/triggerWindow.jpg)
